New videos reach Detour's known-videos list much sooner.

### Changed
- **Hourly updates:** the known-videos list is now rebuilt every hour instead of once a day, and Detour checks for a new version about once an hour instead of every 12 hours. A new upload usually becomes a confident match within about two hours.
- An unchanged list isn't downloaded again: the hourly check is a conditional request.

Everything else is as in [0.5.1](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.5.1).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), or load the zip below.
